items.title: Katie Zacharia out as press secretary after five days
items.summary: Katie Zacharia was out as White House press secretary five days after starting, following a debut briefing of under 15 minutes in which she called her husband "my president," a South Lawn answer of "When I moved to China" when asked where she passed the bar, and a Wall Street Journal report that she had failed the California bar exam. Her tenure became a unit of time on the spot ("Half of a Scaramucci is called a Zacharia"), Scaramucci posted "Records are made to be broken. But I take no pleasure in other people's pain" (27K likes), and the Democrats posted her photo with an #OpenToWork banner. Her exit post calling Trump "kind, wonderful, gracious" drew 93K likes and a pile of mocking quote-posts; her Wikipedia page drew 400K to 900K views a day all week.
items.author: @KatieZacharia

references.title: Anthony Scaramucci Reacts To Katie Zacharia's White House Tenure

post.name: Katie Zacharia
post.text:
President Trump is a kind, wonderful, gracious, thoughtful, enthusiastic, and hardworking man. I wish more Americans appreciated him. No one will ever make America great the way he has and continues to.

It was an honor to work for him.
